name: Whoop
author: William Sturgiss
description: Latest heart rate, last sleep and sync state from the local whoop-poc API, with a panel to sync or start a live HR session.

barWidget.description: Heart rate and last sleep from whoop-poc's local API (127.0.0.1). Left click: panel. Middle: TUI. Right: sync.

schema.label: Status poll interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to read /v1/status. A live session polls every 2 s and a running sync every 5 s regardless.

schema.label: Stale after (minutes)
schema.description: Dim the widget and show a warning icon when the newest strap data is older than this.

schema.label: Show last sleep in the bar
